login.title: Sign in
login.signupHint: Students register here. Staff accounts start with the Microsoft 365 sign-in below.

microsoft.title: Microsoft 365 sign-in
microsoft.signInHint: Staff accounts sign in here with the university Microsoft 365 account. Your first Microsoft 365 sign-in registers your account, then an administrator assigns your role.
microsoft.genericFailure: We could not complete the Microsoft 365 sign-in. Start the sign-in again.

failures.wrong_tenant: This Microsoft account belongs to another organization. Sign in with your university Microsoft 365 account.
failures.outside_staff_domains: This Microsoft account is not a staff account. Staff accounts end in @ejust.edu.eg.
failures.student_account: Student accounts cannot sign in with Microsoft 365. Sign in with your email and password.
failures.identity_bound_elsewhere: This Microsoft account is already linked to another Advisor account. Contact the administration office.
failures.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact the administration office.
failures.cancelled: The Microsoft 365 sign-in was cancelled before it finished.
failures.expired_code: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start the Microsoft 365 sign-in again.
failures.exchange_failed: Microsoft 365 could not confirm the sign-in. Start the sign-in again.

awaitingRole.title: Your account is waiting for an administrator
awaitingRole.body: Your account is registered. An administrator still has to give you a role before you can use Advisor.
awaitingRole.stillWaiting: Your access is not ready yet. An administrator still has to assign your role.
awaitingRole.checkFailed: We could not check your access. Try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.context: Sign up with your student record.
signup.name: Full name
signup.emailHelper: Use your university email ending in @ejust.edu.eg.
signup.studentIdHelper: The ID on your university record.
signup.nationalIdHelper: The 14-digit number on your national ID card.

registered.title: Check your inbox
registered.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. The link expires after 60 minutes.
registered.resendHint: Nothing arrived? Submit the sign-up form again with the same email and student ID to get a new link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.context: We email you a link to set a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent a link to set a new password. The link expires after 60 minutes.
sent.nextStep: Open the link in the email to set a new password.

verify.readyBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
verify.heldTitle: We could not finish setting up your account
verify.heldBody: Contact the administration office to continue.
verify.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.invalidBody: Verification links last 60 minutes. Submit the sign-up form again with the same email to get a new link.
verify.unavailableTitle: The university data service is unavailable
verify.unavailableBody: The link stays valid for 60 minutes, so you can try again later.
verify.mismatchTitle: Your National ID does not match the university record
verify.mismatchBody: The National ID you entered does not match the record for this email. Submit the sign-up form again with the correct National ID.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.successBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
reset.invalidBody: Password reset links last 60 minutes. Request a new link from the sign-in page.

errors.universityEmail: Use your university email ending in @ejust.edu.eg.
errors.credentials: These credentials do not match an account.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.studentIdTaken: This student ID is already registered.
errors.nameMax: Your name is limited to 255 characters.
